create.measure: acknowledgement wall, request latency distribution, records/s and requests/s

index.measure: time from create acknowledgements until pendingIndexCount reaches zero

uuidRead.target: UUID point reads from the loaded fixture

indexedRead.target: unique rank equality queries through the field index

update.target: UUID updates to a mutable non-indexed counter

delete.target: UUID deletes from a disjoint fixture sample

mixed.measure: acknowledged requests/s by type and overall

disk.measure: adapter operations by kind/action, bytes, completions, failures, in-flight, queue depth and per-second rates
disk.completionBoundary: snapshot at index-ready and after each CRUD phase; never wait for disk drain

persistence.description: The worker fixture uses a test persistence stub; external persistence calls and durable acknowledgement are outside this run.

runMetadata.note: The runner stops after index readiness and CRUD phases; it does not wait for disk persistence to drain.
